description: Land Acquisition - Doragamuwa, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District - Passaratown, Passara D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains two separate orders for acquiring servitude rights and taking possession of specific land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the lands, their boundaries, and the purposes of acquisition (construction of access road to a service reservoir). The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
